fr.recommendations:
• Mark the driveway entrance with reflective address numbers visible from both directions on the road.
• Post the address number on the detached structure side facing the access point so responders can distinguish it from the main residence.
• Keep the area in front of the detached structure clear of parked vehicles to allow responders to move between structures without obstruction.
• Mark or sign the single access point clearly so responders arriving for the first time can identify it quickly.
• Keep a designated turning area within the parking zone clear at all times so emergency vehicles can reverse out without maneuvering around parked cars.
• Keep the path between the main residence and the detached structure clear of stored equipment, vehicles, or debris.
• Relocate stored materials from the storage area if they currently narrow or block movement between structures.
• Keep the open lawn area free of parked vehicles or large equipment that would reduce the available staging space for emergency vehicles.
